g.text: Gateways, studios and bots that do the work.
An open-source gateway that keeps coding agents running across hundreds of model providers, a one-Worker
publishing platform, studios for social flows and ad posts, a Telegram funnel server driven over MCP, and a scraper
that turns the web into Markdown.
